content: नकुलः .²1 The mungoose, an ichneumon; यदयं नकुलद्वेषी सकुलद्वेषी पुनः पिशुनः <ls>Vās.</ls> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the fourth Pāṇḍava prince; the twin-brother of Sahadeva and a son of Mādrī. अहं तस्य अतिशयितदिव्यरूपिणो नकुलस्य दर्शनेनोत्सुका जाता <ls>Ve. 2</ls> (where नकुल has really sense 1, but is taken in sense 2 by Duryodhana). .²3 A son. .²4 An epithet of Śiva. .²5 Born of a base family; नकुलः पाण्डुतनये सर्पभुक् कुलहीनयोः <ls>Nm.</ls> .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a physician (author of a work on horses). .{@-ली@} .²1 A female mungoose. .²2 Saffron.
